title: Dash Starts the Conversation: Introducing Dash Pulse
body_markdown:
Your next conversation with Dash can begin with a proposal that needs your review, an opportunity waiting on a decision, or a deadline that deserves a closer look.


With Dash Pulse,[Dash](https://www.govdash.com/dash) brings those priorities to your GovDash homepage in a personalized daily briefing. Each morning, it gathers relevant updates and offers next steps tied to your work, so you can log in with context and get started.


Dash is your AI teammate in GovDash, the AI platform to win and run government contracts. It uses your company’s knowledge and connected workflows to answer questions and work through tasks with your team. Pulse extends that collaboration by giving Dash a way to start the conversation before you send your first message.


### **Start your day with the context you need**


Preparing for the day often requires manually gathering updates, deadlines, and messages. For GovCon teams, this means sifting through proposal reviews, opportunity decisions, and upcoming responses.


Dash Pulse simplifies this process. Each morning, Dash analyzes your connected apps, tasks, calendar, reviews, and opportunities to deliver a tailored briefing. It highlights top to-dos with context, key updates, and a daily overview.


Instead of building a schedule manually, you begin your day with a clear, actionable view of your priorities.


### **Return to your Pulse throughout the day**


Your Pulse remains useful as you work through your priorities. The composer at the bottom lets you ask follow-up questions about anything in the briefing, whether you need to clarify an update or get help with a task.


You can also edit the briefing as your plans change, with changes saved automatically. When you need to look back, past Pulses let you revisit earlier briefings and see what Dash surfaced on a previous day.


### **Building a more proactive Dash**


GovDash is the AI platform to win and run government contracts. Its connected workflows, integrations, and company knowledge give Dash the context to work alongside your team, and Pulse puts that context to use before your first request of the day.


A typical chatbot waits for you to ask a question and provide the context. Dash draws on your company’s knowledge and connected GovCon workflows to surface what needs attention before you ask, then works through tasks with you.


That’s the direction we’re taking with Dash: moving from answering questions to helping carry the work forward. You set the priorities and make the decisions, while Dash brings the context and next steps directly into your workday.


Our[Dash Pulse guide](https://support.govdash.com/docs/dash-pulse) walks through how to use your daily briefing. To see how Dash can support your team’s capture, proposal, and contract workflows,[book a demo](https://www.govdash.com/book-a-demo) .
